correctness.rationale: For every even k>=6, with s=v2(k), h=s+2<k, the unit group ±<5> and v2(5^k-1)=h prove the exact unit-power image. Counting r odd summands (0<=r<=t<2^h) yields disjoint full classes r mod2^h for r>=1, and 2^k times the smaller t-power image for r=0. This gives each finite modulus recurrence without extrapolating from tests. Taking the p-adic inverse limit yields the unique-shell membership condition, compact set, Haar measure via a disjoint scaling equation, bounded k-periodic count discrepancy, and unique boundary point 0. The verifier directly compared 452 complete finite sumsets for nine even exponents, without being treated as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The explicit image sets and exact cardinalities for all even k>=6 and every proper subthreshold t answer a naturally motivated polynomial-image question across an infinite parameter family. The classification distinguishes attainable and forbidden local targets, yields an exact 2-adic density (such as 248/255 for 31 eighth powers) and an unusually precise periodic discrepancy. This is more substantive than recomputing known gamma thresholds or checking a numerical table, although it deliberately reuses the known unit-power subgroup.
